name: Fujita
source:
Fujita.
"For now, my name is Fujita. You will know me as the girl who's life was ruined by the same winds which used to calm me down.
Instead, mass destruction and terror rang throughout my Town. It's as if the winds made up their mind. Backstabbing and painful.
Come find me, I need help making a c̶h̶o̶i̶c̶e̶."

Fujita is a game about a girl who was unfortunate enough to witness the terror of a Tornado.

[From [url=https://bloodceller.itch.io/fujita]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Fujita》。
“暂时，我叫Fujita。你会记得我：那个被同一阵风毁掉人生的女孩。曾经，那阵风总能让我平静下来。
但这一次，我的小镇回荡着大规模破坏与恐惧。仿佛风已经作出决定——背叛、痛苦。
来找我吧，我需要有人帮我作̶出̶抉̶择̶。”

《Fujita》讲述一个女孩不幸目睹龙卷风肆虐的故事。

[来源：[url=https://bloodceller.itch.io/fujita]Itch.io[/url]]
